name: bahia-educacao
description: Módulo de Educação do Bahia API Hub — dados públicos do IBGE.

scripts.dev: npm run build && swift run --build-system native App serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.start: swift run --build-system native -c release App serve --env production --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.check: for f in public/*.js src/worker.js lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run
